One building on a small square base plate, three-quarter view from above and slightly right, centred and filling about 80% of a square image. Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no poster, no queue, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no readable screens, no smoke, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.
